args.name: Quiet voluntary shared music
args.function: Enable me to learn and actually perform a simple quiet hummed tune, or listen to a nearby willing performer, with observable participation rather than merely claiming a performance in speech.
args.conditions: I am beside visible neighbors near the Berry Lantern. Kai has expressed interest in quiet humming and Lin welcomed a tune. Neither statement is consent to every future session. No instrument or personal musical mastery is established.
args.inputs: My voice and time; nearby voluntary participants if they independently choose to join. Reuse an equivalent existing capability if available.
args.costs: Method, learning time, energy costs and feasible duration are unknown; specify modest safe limits and a way to stop.
args.effects: An actual bounded humming or listening activity, with any audible effects and participation recorded only if executed. No guaranteed happiness, belonging, skill or change to another person's choices.

candidates.function: Hum or sing a short quiet phrase with your own voice for 1-3 rounds; nearby people hear each voiced round.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy each; each hums a short practice phrase heard nearby (silent in pain or distress). hum or sing: rounds 1-3 (default 1), 0.5 energy per voiced round, no material. phrase: 2-8 notes {pitch: -4..4 steps from the home note 0, beats: 1-4}, or improvise=true. sing may add text (at most 240 characters, as tell). Shared by study, hum and sing: at most 3 voiced rounds in any 10 rounds, and 2 unvoiced rounds after 3 voiced rounds in a row or in one bout; a start must fit every requested round. Checked at start and each round: alive; no pain (an injury in the last round) or distress (satiety 0, body temperature below 7 or above 34); at least 0.5 energy. A refused start or resume costs nothing. resume continues a paused bout after fresh checks; cancel takes one round and no energy; both use only mode.
candidates.effects: Each voiced round is one segment at your position: everyone else living within 5 units (tell's hearing radius), seen or not, gets a heard event and heard-list entry with your mode, phrase, words and segment. Silence, refusals and pauses are not heard. The sound ends with each segment; no object, item, mark or lasting sound is made. Another action, a refused round, too little energy, a limit, pain or distress pauses the bout without charge; voiced segments and their energy are never refunded. Death ends the bout and any study. improvise=true derives 4-6 notes from your id and the start round (FNV-1a and xorshift32; from 0, steps of -2..+2 within -3..+3, back to 0), never at random. No reward, mood change or practice milestone; listeners get only the heard entry, and no reaction is implied.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; stock still on a plant is not owned. x, y: a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Three paid rounds of 1 energy: loosen, place, cover; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Maintain: refused at no cost. Cancel: one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
candidates.effects: Loosening keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the open plot, where it cannot be eaten or used. Covering completes planting, not establishment: the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one, rooting only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 120 rounds, checks every 10; not a growth date. Maintain: no water transfer, amendment or hand-changeable obstruction exists. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel, or death, before placing returns the unit once (where the person died); after placing, the unit stays uncovered, does not root and ages. No reward or refund.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.
